name: first-boot
title: First boot of the freshly installed system
description: Boot the installed disk under UEFI and require the system to reach its boot targets with the Bunny health check finished. Serial output is the primary evidence; the offline journal collection afterwards owns the deeper assertions.
$markerNote: 'Startup finished in' is a journal line, not a console status line — measured absent from serial while every status marker flowed — so startup completion is carried by the boot-target marker and the timing line belongs to the offline journal collection.
